author: David Wilson
title: 'You've Got to Be Kidding Me': Trump Responds to '90s Epstein Photos - NewsBreak
text: Resurfaced photos from President Donald Trump’s 1990s wedding to Marla Maples have sparked controversy, showing Jeffrey Epstein in attendance at the Plaza Hotel. The images have fueled ongoing scrutiny regarding the Trump administration’s perceived lack of transparency in handling investigations linked to Epstein. Critics have accused Attorney General Pam Bondi of withholding key information on the case to protect the President. When questioned about the photo, Trump said, “You’ve got to be kidding me.” Rep. Thomas Massie (R-KY) said, “Well, you know, the files exist. There are some files there. This is not a hoax. I’m convinced – based on the things that the FBI director and Pam Bondi said earlier and JD Vance – that these files are there.” Footage from a Victoria’s Secret fashion show in the 1990s also showed Trump socializing with Epstein. In response to questions regarding the photos, Trump criticized the reporting as “fake news.” The Trump administration has faced significant backlash for its handling of the Epstein Files. Despite officials’ previous promises to release a supposed client list, the Department of Justice (DOJ) now claims no such list exists. Critics have suspected a cover-up, while Trump has largely dismissed the issue. Attorneys representing Epstein associate Ghislaine Maxwell wrote, “As counsel for Ms. Maxwell, we would similarly like to review the grand jury transcripts at issue (we have not seen them and our understanding is that they have never been provided to the defense in their entirety) in order to craft a response and set out our position to the Court.” House Speaker Mike Johnson said, “There’s no purpose for the Congress to push an administration to do something they’re already doing.” Johnson added, “The same Democrats who lied to us for years are now trying to convince you they stand for transparency.” David Wilson covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
